newvmcomputers.setup.title: VM Computers: %clSetup
newvmcomputers.setup.intro_message:
You need to install VirtualBox (version 6.1.*) for this mod to work.
If you haven't done it yet, download and install it from %clvirtualbox.org
or your package manager. If you need to restart, do it and come back.

WARNING! This might cause VirtualBox to stop working, resulting in you having
to reset your preferences. (If that happens, just google how to reset)

%caVirtualBox %s works!
